status: Analytic electrode heat scales, not completed thermal or repeated-jet simulations

driver.method: Exact integrals of piecewise-linear prescribed current; V=IR+L dI/dt. Head modeled as constant cold resistance. Four-quadrant current regulation assumed.
limitations: No PWM ripple, switching/gate losses, current-loop dynamics, bus/lead ringing or protection design.
No capacitor ESR/ripple rating or switch SOA/temperature qualification.
Input R and L assumptions must be replaced with measured assembled values; motional voltage is omitted from this lumped check.
Electrical compliance is not a droplet or repetition-rate prediction.

limits: Uniform full current in each dry rod; excludes immersed-section current distribution and contact losses.
Constant-property engineering assumptions; large predicted rises invalidate the approximation rather than qualify an operating temperature.
Steady estimate solves k*T''+q=0 for equal fixed end temperatures; liquid and clamp cooling must actually maintain those boundaries. No radiation, gas convection or transient heat transfer.
Identical repeated current pulses assumed; no demonstrated droplet repetition rate.
